title: Newsletter
brief:
A monthly newsletter, The Orbit Dispatch.

- Preview text: "Two stories from the Orbit team this month."
- Orbit logo at the top: https://assets.orbit.dev/img/orbit-logo.png (show it 126px wide).
- Heading: "The Orbit Dispatch: November"
- Two stories. Each story is two columns, the image on the left and the text on the right; on phones they stack, image first:
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/newsletter-hero.png (1200×500 file). Title "Designing for every inbox". Text "What we learned rendering a million emails." Link "Read more" to https://orbit.dev/blog/every-inbox.
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/event-hero.png (1200×600 file). Title "Orbit Summit recap". Text "Talks, demos and what's next for Orbit." Link "Watch the talks" to https://orbit.dev/summit/talks.
- Footer: "Orbit Labs, 500 Market St, San Francisco" and an "Unsubscribe" link to https://orbit.dev/unsubscribe.
- Light grey page background (#f1f2f6), white 600px content card.
